payload.tension: The passage states wise walking becomes song, thanks, and mutual submission. Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise, subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
